ready.title: Config ready
ready.description: This page is using the audio API assigned to the current task.

audio_api_not_configured.title: No audio API is configured

audio_route_not_configured.title: This audio API has no usable route for the current task
audio_route_not_configured.description: Enable a compatible route for this task in audio settings.

transcriber.title: Audio to text
transcriber.description: Transcribe local audio with the currently assigned audio API.

speech.title: Text to audio
speech.description: Generate audio with the currently assigned audio API.

captions.title: Realtime captions
captions.description: Turn microphone input into live captions with the current audio API.

voice.title: Duplex voice

hints.mimo_response_format: MiMo ASR supports JSON or plain text output in the first version.
hints.openai_response_format: OpenAI Audio supports JSON, plain text, and subtitle formats depending on the model.
hints.timestamps: Timestamps are enabled only for OpenAI verbose JSON output; MiMo docs do not expose this capability.
hints.prompt: Use this for names, product terms, or domain context. MiMo ASR does not support prompts.
hints.stream: File streaming transcription and realtime captions are separate capabilities.
hints.stream_enabled: This model supports file transcription over SSE. The completed transcript is shown after the stream ends.
hints.output_mode: Source or custom folders write the transcript file when the task completes.

placeholders.prompt: Names, product terms, glossary, or domain context

file.title: Choose an audio file
file.openai_description: Supports wav, mp3, m4a, mp4, flac, ogg, and webm. Recommended under 25MB.
file.mimo_description: MiMo ASR only accepts wav / mp3 and must stay under 10MB after Base64 encoding.

empty.title: Waiting for audio
empty.description: Choose a file and confirm the settings. The transcript will appear here.
empty.running_description: The request is using the currently assigned audio API. Keep this page open.

errors.title: Transcription failed
errors.file_path_unavailable: FusionKit could not authorize this file for the main process. Choose it again inside the Electron app.
errors.file_authorizing: Wait for file authorization to finish.
errors.unsupported_file: This audio format is not supported.
errors.unsupported_file_for_mimo: MiMo ASR currently supports only wav or mp3 files.
errors.file_too_large: The audio file exceeds the size limit for the current protocol.
errors.output_dir_required: Select an output folder before using custom folder mode.
errors.output_not_ready: There is no output file to open yet.
errors.copy_failed: Copy failed. Please copy the result manually.
errors.cancel_failed: The transcription request could not be cancelled.
errors.save_failed: The current transcript could not be saved.

hints.mode: Only modes configured and available on the current audio API are shown.
hints.mimo_voice: Preset voice mode uses voice; voice design does not, and voice clone uses reference audio.
hints.openai_voice: OpenAI voice can be typed manually; presets are only shortcuts.
hints.mimo_format: MiMo non-streaming output is fixed to WAV. Streaming is fixed to PCM16 and saved as WAV when complete.
hints.openai_format: OpenAI official TTS supports multiple binary audio formats.
hints.speed: This option appears only when the current audio API supports speed control.
hints.stream: Play audio as it arrives; the current audio API determines the wire format.
hints.stream_on: Streaming plays PCM16 chunks as they arrive, then switches to the final file.
hints.stream_off: Non-streaming waits for the full audio response before playback.
hints.output_mode: Temporary files can be played; custom folders write directly to the selected folder.
hints.voice_design: Voice design requires a description of the voice you want.
hints.voice_clone: Voice clone requires a wav or mp3 reference file, authorized once for the main process to read.
hints.input: Text to synthesize. MiMo voice design may leave this empty when optimizing preview text.
hints.file_name_hint: Leave off the extension; it will be added from the output format.

placeholders.mimo_voice: mimo_default / 冰糖 / Mia / custom voice id
placeholders.style_instruction: For example: softer, narrator-like, natural pacing
placeholders.voice_design_prompt: For example: young, bright, friendly female voice
placeholders.instructions: For example: keep a calm tone for podcast narration

voice_sample.title: Choose reference audio
voice_sample.description: Used only for voice clone mode. Supports wav / mp3.

empty.title: Waiting for text
empty.description: Enter text and confirm settings. The player will appear when generation completes.
empty.running_description: The request is using the current global audio configuration. Keep this page open.

messages.mode_fallback: The generation mode was switched for the new audio API.

errors.output_dir_required: Select an output folder before using custom folder mode.

errors.voice_sample_required: Voice clone mode requires reference audio.

errors.unsupported_voice_sample: Reference audio supports only wav or mp3.

hints.language: Only languages supported by the current audio API route are shown. Auto detect omits the language field.
hints.input_audio_format: Realtime supports PCM16, PCMU, and PCMA. PCM16 is the recommended default.
hints.output_format: TXT saves plain text. SRT uses local session time to generate a basic timeline.

chunked.title: Chunked near-realtime
chunked.description: This mode encodes microphone input into short WAV chunks and lets the main process transcribe each chunk with the current audio API route. It is not a WebRTC duplex session.

empty.title: Waiting for microphone input
empty.description: Starting will request microphone permission and show realtime captions here.
empty.running_description: Start speaking and partial/final captions will appear here.

errors.title: Realtime captions failed
errors.unsupported_mode: The current audio API does not support realtime captions.
errors.chunked_unavailable: The current audio API cannot start chunked near-realtime captions.
errors.copy_failed: Copy failed. Please copy the captions manually.
